Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — getting started is simple. Here’s the easiest way to begin with Nurosym:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear).
Clip the earpiece to your left tragus, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling.
Use it for 15–60 minutes per session while relaxing or doing normal activities. 
Many people use it daily for about 30–60 minutes, often in the morning or split between morning and evening. You can read, work, meditate, or watch TV while using it. 
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually increase as it feels comfortable.
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before starting.
